    draw an 8 separator on the other side, preserving the figure's cell pattern."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    for mr, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg:
            marker = row[0]
            colors = [v for v in counts if v not in (bg, marker)]
            if not colors:
                return out
            color = max(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
            cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] == color]
            top = min(r for r, c in cells)
            bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
            if mr > bottom:
                shift = mr - 1 - bottom
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = bg
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r + shift][c] = color
                out[top + shift - 1] = [8] * w
            else:
                shift = mr + 1 - top
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = bg
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r + shift][c] = color
                out[bottom + shift + 1] = [8] * w
